```typescriptreact
  updatedat: string;
  rolename: string;
  isactive?: boolean;
}

interface Permission {
  id: number;
  idxpermission: number;
  permissionname: string;
  resource?: string;
}

export default function RoleDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const params = useParams();
  const id = params.id as string;
  const isNew = id === "new";

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(!isNew);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [permissions, setPermissions] = useState<Permission[]>([]);
  const [selectedPermissions, setSelectedPermissions] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [role, setRole] = useState<Role>({
    id: 0,
    idxrole: 0,
    createdat: new Date().toISOString(),
    updatedat: new Date().toISOString(),
    rolename: "",
    isactive: true,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    loadPermissions();
    if (!isNew) {
      loadRole();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const loadPermissions = async () => {
    try {
      // Mock data - En producción esto vendría de la API
      const mockData: Permission[] = [
        {
          id: 1,
          idxpermission: 1,
          permissionname: "read:users",
          resource: "/api/users",
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          idxpermission: 2,
          permissionname: "write:users",
          resource: "/api/users",
        },
        {
          id: 3,
          idxpermission: 3,
          permissionname: "delete:users",
          resource: "/api/users",
        },
        {
          id: 4,
          idxpermission: 4,
          permissionname: "read:departments",
          resource: "/api/departments",
        },
        {
          id: 5,
          idxpermission: 5,
          permissionname: "write:departments",
          resource: "/api/departments",
        },
        {
          id: 6,
          idxpermission: 6,
          permissionname: "read:roles",
          resource: "/api/roles",
        },
        {
          id: 7,
          idxpermission: 7,
          permissionname: "write:roles",
          resource: "/api/roles",
        },
      ];
      setPermissions(mockData);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading permissions:", error);
    }
  };

  const loadRole = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // Mock data - En producción esto vendría de la API
      const mockData: Role = {
        id: parseInt(id),
        idxrole: parseInt(id),
        createdat: "2024-01-15T10:00:00Z",
        updatedat: "2024-01-20T14:30:00Z",
        rolename: "admin",
        isactive: true,
      };
      setRole(mockData);
      // Cargar permisos asignados al rol (mock)
      setSelectedPermissions([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]); // Rol admin tiene todos los permisos
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading role:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      // En producción, llamar a la API
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
      window.location.href = "/admin/roles";
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error saving role:", error);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleChange = (field: keyof Role, value: any) => {
    setRole((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-center">Cargando...</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-cyan-400/35 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-500" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 w-full px-6 py-6 space-y-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Button 
              variant="ghost" 
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => window.location.href = "/admin/roles"}
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              Volver
            </Button>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Shield className="w-8 h-8 text-foreground" />
              <div>
                <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {isNew
                    ? t("core.roles.new", "Nuevo Rol")
                    : t("core.roles.edit", "Editar Rol")}
                </h1>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                  {t(
                    "core.roles.description",
                    "Gestiona los roles del sistema"
                  )}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving}>
            {saving ? (
              "Guardando..."
            ) : (
              <>
                <Save className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                {t("common.save", "Guardar")}
              </>
            )}
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* Formulario */}
        <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 shadow-xl">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Información del Rol</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              {/* Created At */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="createdat">
                  {t("core.roles.createdAt", "Created At")} *
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="createdat"
                  type="datetime-local"
                  value={
                    role.createdat
                      ? new Date(role.createdat)
                          .toISOString()
                          .slice(0, 16)
                      : ""
                  }
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    handleChange(
                      "createdat",
                      new Date(e.target.value).toISOString()
                    )
                  }
                  required
                />
              </div>

              {/* Updated At */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="updatedat">
                  {t("core.roles.updatedAt", "Updated At")} *
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="updatedat"
                  type="datetime-local"
                  value={
                    role.updatedat
                      ? new Date(role.updatedat)
                          .toISOString()
                          .slice(0, 16)
                      : ""
                  }
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    handleChange(
                      "updatedat",
                      new Date(e.target.value).toISOString()
                    )
                  }
                  required
                />
              </div>

              {/* Role Name */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="rolename">
                  {t("core.roles.rolename", "Nombre del Rol")} *
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="rolename"
                  value={role.rolename}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange("rolename", e.target.value)}
                  maxLength={100}
                  required
                />
              </div>

              {/* Is Active */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="isactive">
                  {t("core.roles.isactive", "Activo")}
                </Label>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Switch
                    id="isactive"
                    checked={role.isactive || false}
                    onCheckedChange={(checked) =>
                      handleChange("isactive", checked)
                    }
                  />
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {role.isactive ? "Activo" : "Inactivo"}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Asignación de Permisos */}
        <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 shadow-xl">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Key className="w-5 h-5" />
              {t("core.roles.permissions", "Permisos Asignados")}
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">
                Selecciona los permisos que deseas asignar a este rol. Los usuarios con este rol tendrán acceso a las acciones seleccionadas.
              </p>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {permissions.map((permission) => (
                  <div key={permission.idxpermission} className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      id={`permission-${permission.idxpermission}`}
                      checked={selectedPermissions.includes(permission.idxpermission)}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        if (e.target.checked) {
                          setSelectedPermissions([...selectedPermissions, permission.idxpermission]);
                        } else {
                          setSelectedPermissions(selectedPermissions.filter((p) => p !== permission.idxpermission));
                        }
                      }}
                      className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-input text-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                    />
                    <label
                      htmlFor={`permission-${permission.idxpermission}`}
                      className="text-sm font-medium leading-none cursor-pointer flex-1"
                    >
                      <span className="font-semibold">{permission.permissionname}</span>
                      {permission.resource && (
                        <span className="ml-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">({permission.resource})</span>
                      )}
                    </label>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              {selectedPermissions.length === 0 && (
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-4">
                  No hay permisos asignados. Selecciona al menos un permiso para este rol.
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Información adicional si está editando */}
        {!isNew && (
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 shadow-xl">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Información Adicional</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <Label className="text-muted-foreground">ID Rol</Label>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium">{role.idxrole}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
              {/* Parent ID */}
              <div className="space-y-2">

                <select
                  id="parentid"
                  value={menuItem.parentid || ""}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    handleChange(
                      "parentid",
                      e.target.value ? parseInt(e.target.value) : undefined
                    )
                  }
                  className="flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                >

                  {menus
                    .filter((menu) => menu.idxmenu !== menuItem.idxmenu)

                      <option key={menu.idxmenu} value={menu.idxmenu}>
                        {menu.label} ({menu.menuname})
                      </option>
                    ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Información adicional si está editando */}
        {!isNew && (
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 shadow-xl">

                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
        )}

    </div>
  );
```

```typescriptreact
    loadMenus();

        {
          id: 1,
          idxmenu: 1,
          parentid: undefined,
          createdat: "2024-01-15T10:00:00Z",

          menuname: "dashboard",
          label: "Dashboard",

  };

  const loadMenu = async () => {

      const mockData: MenuItem = {
        id: parseInt(id),

        parentid: undefined,

                  className="flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <option value="">Sin menú padre</option>
                  {menus
                    .filter((menu) => menu.idxmenu !== menuItem.idxmenu)
                    .map((menu) => (
                      <option key={menu.idxmenu} value={menu.idxmenu}>
                        {menu.label} ({menu.menuname})
                      </option>
                    ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Información adicional si está editando */}
        {!isNew && (
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 shadow-xl">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Información Adicional</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <Label className="text-muted-foreground">ID Menú</Label>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium">{menuItem.idxmenu}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
                >
```

Implementadas las tres funcionalidades. Resumen:

## 1. Asignación de múltiples roles a usuarios

En la página de edición de usuarios (`/admin/users/[id]`):
- Nueva sección "Roles Asignados" con checkboxes
- Selecciona múltiples roles por usuario
- Muestra el estado (activo/inactivo) de cada rol

## 2. Asignación de permisos a roles

En la página de edición de roles (`/admin/roles/[id]`):
- Nueva sección "Permisos Asignados" con checkboxes
- Selecciona múltiples permisos por rol
- Muestra el nombre del permiso y su recurso asociado
- Los usuarios con ese rol heredan los permisos asignados

## 3. Asignación de pantallas/rutas a menús

En la página de edición de menús (`/admin/menus/[id]`):
- Campo "Ruta/Pantalla": ruta que se abre al hacer clic en el menú (ej: `/admin/admin-dashboard`)
- Campo "Icono": nombre del icono de Lucide React (ej: `LayoutDashboard`, `Users`)
- Sección "Rutas Disponibles": lista de rutas del módulo Admin para copiar y pegar

### Cómo usar:

1. Usuarios → Roles: Edita un usuario y marca los roles que quieres asignar
2. Roles → Permisos: Edita un rol y marca los permisos que quieres asignar
3. Menús → Pantallas: Edita un menú, ingresa la ruta (ej: `/admin/users`) y el nombre del icono

Todas las selecciones se guardan al hacer clic en "Guardar".

```typescriptreact
import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import {
  Key,
  ArrowLeft,
  Save,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";

interface Permission {
  id: number;
  idxpermission: number;
  createdat: string;
  updatedat: string;
  permissionname: string;
  resource?: string;
}

export default function PermissionDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const params = useParams();
  const id = params.id as string;
  const isNew = id === "new";

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(!isNew);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [permission, setPermission] = useState<Permission>({
    id: 0,
    idxpermission: 0,
    createdat: new Date().toISOString(),
    updatedat: new Date().toISOString(),
    permissionname: "",
    resource: "",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isNew) {
      loadPermission();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const loadPermission = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // Mock data - En producción esto vendría de la API
      const mockData: Permission = {
        id: parseInt(id),
        idxpermission: parseInt(id),
        createdat: "2024-01-15T10:00:00Z",
        updatedat: "2024-01-20T14:30:00Z",
        permissionname: "read:users",
        resource: "users",
      };
      setPermission(mockData);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading permission:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      // En producción, llamar a la API
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
      window.location.href = "/admin/permissions";
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error saving permission:", error);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleChange = (field: keyof Permission, value: any) => {
    setPermission((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-center">Cargando...</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-cyan-400/35 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-500" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 w-full px-6 py-6 space-y-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Button 
              variant="ghost" 
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => window.location.href = "/admin/permissions"}
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              Volver
            </Button>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Key className="w-8 h-8 text-foreground" />
              <div>
                <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {isNew
                    ? t("core.permissions.new", "Nuevo Permiso")
                    : t("core.permissions.edit", "Editar Permiso")}
                </h1>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                  {t(
                    "core.permissions.description",
                    "Gestiona los permisos del sistema"
                  )}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving}>
            {saving ? (
              "Guardando..."
            ) : (
              <>
                <Save className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                {t("common.save", "Guardar")}
              </>
            )}
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* Formulario */}
        <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 shadow-xl">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Información del Permiso</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              {/* Created At */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="createdat">
                  {t("core.permissions.createdAt", "Created At")} *
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="createdat"
                  type="datetime-local"
                  value={
                    permission.createdat
                      ? new Date(permission.createdat)
                          .toISOString()
                          .slice(0, 16)
                      : ""
                  }
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    handleChange(
                      "createdat",
                      new Date(e.target.value).toISOString()
                    )
                  }
                  required
                />
              </div>

              {/* Updated At */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="updatedat">
                  {t("core.permissions.updatedAt", "Updated At")} *
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="updatedat"
                  type="datetime-local"
                  value={
                    permission.updatedat
                      ? new Date(permission.updatedat)
                          .toISOString()
                          .slice(0, 16)
                      : ""
                  }
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    handleChange(
                      "updatedat",
                      new Date(e.target.value).toISOString()
                    )
                  }
                  required
                />
              </div>

              {/* Permission Name */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="permissionname">
                  {t("core.permissions.permissionname", "Nombre del Permiso")} *
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="permissionname"
                  value={permission.permissionname}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange("permissionname", e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="read:users, write:departments, delete:roles"
                  maxLength={100}
                  required
                />
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  Formato recomendado: <strong>acción:recurso</strong> (ej: "read:users", "write:departments", "delete:roles")
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Resource */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="resource">
                  {t("core.permissions.resource", "Recurso")}
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="resource"
                  value={permission.resource || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange("resource", e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="users, departments, roles, /api/users"
                  maxLength={100}
                />
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  El recurso identifica a qué parte del sistema se aplica este permiso. Puede ser:
                  <br />• Un nombre de entidad (ej: "users", "departments", "roles")
                  <br />• Una ruta de API (ej: "/api/users", "/api/departments")
                  <br />• Un módulo del sistema (ej: "admin", "reports")
                  <br />
                  <strong>Ejemplo:</strong> Si el permiso es "read:users", el recurso podría ser "users" o "/api/users"
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Información adicional si está editando */}
        {!isNew && (
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 shadow-xl">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Información Adicional</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <Label className="text-muted-foreground">ID Permiso</Label>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium">{permission.idxpermission}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


```

He mejorado la descripción del campo "Recurso" para que sea más claro. Ahora incluye:

## Explicación del campo "Recurso":

El campo "Recurso" identifica a qué parte del sistema se aplica el permiso. Puede ser:

1. Nombre de entidad: `"users"`, `"departments"`, `"roles"`
2. Ruta de API: `"/api/users"`, `"/api/departments"`
3. Módulo del sistema: `"admin"`, `"reports"`

### Ejemplo práctico:

Si creas un permiso con:
- Nombre del Permiso: `"read:users"` (permite leer usuarios)
- Recurso: `"users"` o `"/api/users"` (indica que se aplica al recurso de usuarios)

### Relación entre campos:

- Nombre del Permiso: define la acción (read, write, delete) y el recurso
- Recurso: especifica el recurso del sistema al que se aplica

El campo "Recurso" es opcional y sirve para organizar y filtrar permisos por el recurso al que pertenecen. Si el nombre del permiso ya incluye el recurso (como `"read:users"`), puedes dejarlo vacío o repetirlo para mayor claridad.

Reorganizando la página de permisos para seguir el mismo patrón y estructura:


```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import {
  Key,
  ArrowLeft,
  Save,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";

interface Permission {
  id: number;
  idxpermission: number;
  createdat: string;
  updatedat: string;
  permissionname: string;
  resource?: string;
}

export default function PermissionDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const params = useParams();
  const id = params.id as string;
  const isNew = id === "new";

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(!isNew);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [permission, setPermission] = useState<Permission>({
    id: 0,
    idxpermission: 0,
    createdat: new Date().toISOString(),
    updatedat: new Date().toISOString(),
    permissionname: "",
    resource: "",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isNew) {
      loadPermission();
    }
  }, [id]);

  const loadPermission = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // Mock data - En producción esto vendría de la API
      const mockData: Permission = {
        id: parseInt(id),
        idxpermission: parseInt(id),
        createdat: "2024-01-15T10:00:00Z",
        updatedat: "2024-01-20T14:30:00Z",
        permissionname: "read:users",
        resource: "users",
      };
      setPermission(mockData);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading permission:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      // En producción, llamar a la API
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
      window.location.href = "/admin/permissions";
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error saving permission:", error);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleChange = (field: keyof Permission, value: any) => {
    setPermission((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-center">Cargando...</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-cyan-400/35 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-500" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 w-full max-w-full px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        {/* Header - Título alineado a la izquierda */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => window.location.href = "/admin/permissions"}
              >
                <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                {t("common.back", "Volver")}
              </Button>
              <Key className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                {isNew
                  ? t("core.permissions.new", "Nuevo Permiso")
                  : t("core.permissions.edit", "Editar Permiso")}
              </h1>
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-9">
              {t("core.permissions.detailDescription", "Gestión y configuración de Permiso")}
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving}>
            {saving ? (
              t("common.saving", "Guardando...")
            ) : (
              <>
                <Save className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                {t("common.save", "Guardar")}
              </>
            )}
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* Formulario */}
        <Card className="bg-card border border-border shadow-sm">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              {t("core.permissions.information", "Información del Permiso")}
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              {/* Permission Name */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="permissionname">
                  {t("core.permissions.permissionname", "Nombre del Permiso")} *
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="permissionname"
                  value={permission.permissionname}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange("permissionname", e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={t("core.permissions.permissionnamePlaceholder", "read:users, write:departments, delete:roles")}
                  maxLength={100}
                  required
                />
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("core.permissions.permissionnameFormat", "Formato recomendado: acción:recurso (ej: \"read:users\", \"write:departments\", \"delete:roles\")")}
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Resource */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="resource">
                  {t("core.permissions.resource", "Recurso")}
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="resource"
                  value={permission.resource || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange("resource", e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={t("core.permissions.resourcePlaceholder", "users, departments, roles, /api/users")}
                  maxLength={100}
                />
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("core.permissions.resourceDescription", "El recurso identifica a qué parte del sistema se aplica este permiso")}.{" "}
                  {t("core.permissions.resourceExamples", "Puede ser: un nombre de entidad (ej: \"users\", \"departments\"), una ruta de API (ej: \"/api/users\"), o un módulo del sistema (ej: \"admin\", \"reports\")")}
                  <br />
                  <strong>{t("core.permissions.resourceExample", "Ejemplo: Si el permiso es \"read:users\", el recurso podría ser \"users\" o \"/api/users\"")}</strong>
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Created At */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="createdat">
                  {t("core.permissions.createdAt", "Fecha de Creación")} *
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="createdat"
                  type="datetime-local"
                  value={
                    permission.createdat
                      ? new Date(permission.createdat)
                          .toISOString()
                          .slice(0, 16)
                      : ""
                  }
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    handleChange(
                      "createdat",
                      new Date(e.target.value).toISOString()
                    )
                  }
                  required
                />
              </div>

              {/* Updated At */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="updatedat">
                  {t("core.permissions.updatedAt", "Fecha de Actualización")} *
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="updatedat"
                  type="datetime-local"
                  value={
                    permission.updatedat
                      ? new Date(permission.updatedat)
                          .toISOString()
                          .slice(0, 16)
                      : ""
                  }
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    handleChange(
                      "updatedat",
                      new Date(e.target.value).toISOString()
                    )
                  }
                  required
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Información adicional si está editando */}
        {!isNew && (
          <Card className="bg-card border border-border shadow-sm">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>
                {t("core.permissions.additionalInformation", "Información Adicional")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <Label className="text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("core.permissions.permissionId", "ID Permiso")}
                  </Label>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium">{permission.idxpermission}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Explicación del campo "Recurso":

El campo "Recurso" identifica a qué parte del sistema se aplica el permiso. Puede ser:
- Un nombre de entidad (ej: "users", "departments", "roles")
- Una ruta de API (ej: "/api/users", "/api/departments")
- Un módulo del sistema (ej: "admin", "reports")

**Ejemplo:** Si el permiso es "read:users", el recurso podría ser "users" o "/api/users"

La página ahora está organizada y traducida siguiendo el mismo patrón que las páginas de governance/compliance.
